claim: GitLab documents digital customer programmes including onboarding resources, enablement email series, newsletters, webinars, education and playbook maintenance.
notes: One transparent company example. It supports the distinction between a digital programme and a complete customer outcome, not a universal programme design.

claim: GitLab documents the use of A/B tests and control groups to assess digital programme effectiveness and adjust programmes before wider use.
source_title: Getting Help from Digital Customer Success Programs
notes: Supports measuring programme effect rather than treating delivery activity as proof. No benchmark or causal result is imported.

claim: Gainsight describes Digital Customer Success as combining personalised, proactive and predictive digital experiences with human touchpoints.
notes: Vendor guidance, not independent industry evidence. Used only to show that even a digital-CS vendor frames the model as a mix of digital and human touchpoints.
